CustomObject.description: The Admin Journal: what an admin tool keeps so it can show progress or be undone, one row per item, by Kind: Merge (one merge, R-DP10), Scan and Deactivation (an automation snapshot, Section 10A), Migration (one Migration Kit run, Section 29ZS) and Household Adoption (one adopted Account, Section 29ZQ). Every query reads one kind. Private: a row belongs to the administrator whose tool wrote it, and BarnCRM Admin sees and changes all of them (ADR-NEXT fewer custom objects).
CustomObject.label: Admin Journal
